reader_summary.headline: Lane MacDonald is the Chief Investment Officer of SCS Financial.
reader_summary.overview: Lane MacDonald is the Chief Investment Officer of SCS Financial, a registered investment adviser and OCIO platform with approximately $46 billion in assets under management. Olympic hockey player and Hobey Baker award winner as the best player in college hockey in the late '80s. In the decades since.

key_points.text: Olympic hockey player and Hobey Baker award winner as the best player in college hockey in the late '80s.
Our conversation traces Lane's path from the rink to investing, and from dealmaker to allocator, examining what separates great investors from good ones.
